32 SMs and requested QP=65 for both variants
Above 1×: faster than baseline. Below 1×: regression. Every measured token size is shown.
B200 • 8 GPUs/domain • BF16 LL/RM • H7168/K8/E256 • median of two dispatch invocation averages.
Open squares: separate tail-retry allocations; lines do not bridge cohorts. No samples pooled across jobs.
Historical fe66c050 data. Small-token variability is visible; two invocations cannot establish statistical non-regression.
